# WHEN TO USE

- Creating a new custom agent under `.github/agents/`.
- Repairing or rewriting an existing `.agent.md` file.
- Updating the canonical agent template, agent validation script, or agent-authoring guidance.
- Reviewing why workspace agent instructions, templates, or validators disagree.
- Any task in this workspace that is specifically about custom agents rather than skills, prompts, or MCP servers.
